snippet.title: OPERATION OBLIT 2 Level 1 : GHETTO FUMIGATION
snippet.description:
Free demo is available Now on our Steam Store! Be sure to wish list it!

The following clip shows the game systems in action.  First the game launcher starts on a PC desktop, all levels are available: nothing is locked. Next is a pre-loader app, followed by studio watermark, game menu and game loading files. The loading files are faster in the video than real life. 

After the game loads, you will notice the Custom designed HUD health bar that extends the entire length of the screen.On the right is the stance indicator and low health warning along with health and lives. On the right, reload indicator, kill confirmed indicator, weapon chosen, bullets in weapon magazine and bullets total carried by the soldier.

OPERATION OBLITERATION 2 LEVEL 1:GHETTO FUMIGATIONS LORE:
You crawl out of a sewer pipe into the outskirts of a cleared ghetto. The occupiers have already finished their unholy roundup. The streets are empty. What remains is debris, silence, and armed fascists looting the ruins like common thieves. Advance down the main street and eliminate all hostile forces. This level is built to keep you off balance at all times. Enemy
threats appear at street level, from Rooftops & more, be sure to keep your eyes open!

Operation Obliteration 2 is designed to be played in a native 1080 Resolution.  Other screen sizes will work although not all elements will line up correctly.  Non-sequential game play means loadouts don't carry over from previous level. Single player only.

FREE DEMO AVAILABLE NOW ON STEAM! GET YOURS AND GET IN THE WAR!
website: https://oblitgamewerks.github.io/OB/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4257370/Operation_Obliteration_2/
Demo: https://operationobliteration.itch.io/ also on steam
Contact: oblitgamewerks@mail.com
